user.title: Tuya Pilot Wire Companion
user.description: The Companion reads pilot-wire thermostats from MQTT bridges. Give the topic prefix of each bridge to read, separated by commas.

error.invalid_prefixes: Give at least one prefix; letters, digits, hyphen and underscore only.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

bridges.title: Bridges
bridges.description: The Companion reads pilot-wire thermostats from MQTT bridges. Give the topic prefix of each bridge to read, separated by commas.

add_room.title: Add a room
add_room.description: A room groups thermostats and shows one thermostat for all of them. A thermostat belongs to one room at most. Nothing is sent to the devices.

room.title: Room {room}
room.description: A room groups thermostats and shows one thermostat for all of them. A thermostat belongs to one room at most. Nothing is sent to the devices.

delete_room.title: Delete a room
delete_room.description: The room's thermostats stay, each with its own thermostat entity. Nothing is sent to the devices.

trial.title: Supervised write trial
trial.description: Designate the single thermostat the write under trial may address: its manual setpoint. The control appears only once its bridge accepts writes. Choose “—” to close it again. A trial is run with the owner's agreement on the exact operation and recorded in docs/validation.

error.invalid_prefixes: Give at least one prefix; letters, digits, hyphen and underscore only.
error.room_name_taken: Another room already has this name.
error.thermostat_in_other_room: One of these thermostats already belongs to another room.

abort.not_loaded: The Tuya Pilot Wire Companion is not loaded.

no_write_route.message: This thermostat is read only for now: no write route is open in the Companion.

not_loaded.message: The Tuya Pilot Wire Companion is not loaded.

thermostat_in_other_room.message: A thermostat already belongs to the room "{room}".

thermostat_unavailable.message: This thermostat is not responding: nothing was sent.

value_out_of_bounds.message: The value must be between {low} and {high}, in steps of {step}: nothing was sent.

set_no_answer.message: The bridge did not answer the command. Nothing is assumed: the value shown is the last one the device confirmed.

create_room.name: Create a room
create_room.description: Creates a room and puts thermostats in it. Changes Home Assistant storage only; nothing is sent to the devices.

thermostats.name: Thermostats
thermostats.description: Thermostats of the room: device ids, or the names the bridge gives them.

update_room.name: Update a room
update_room.description: Renames a room and/or replaces its thermostats. Nothing is sent to the devices.

room.name: Room
room.description: The room: its device id, or its name.

thermostats.name: Thermostats
thermostats.description: The full list of the room's thermostats; it replaces the current one.

delete_room.name: Delete a room
delete_room.description: Deletes a room. Its thermostats stay, each with its own thermostat entity.

room.name: Room
room.description: The room: its device id, or its name.

list_rooms.name: List the rooms
list_rooms.description: Returns the rooms, their thermostats, and the thermostats outside any room.
